data.name: Horror Game Creator
data.detailed_description:
The Perfect Horror Game... is the one you made!

Horror Game Creator is a powerful sandbox tool that lets you design, customize, and explore your own liminal horror experiences. Inspired by the endless, eerie maze of the haunted, this creator gives you full control to shape unsettling worlds, craft unique encounters, and define how players survive them. Then, SHARE the SEED Code so others can PLAY!

Build your own levels using modular environments, connect rooms into sprawling labyrinths, and control every detail—from lighting and atmosphere to enemies, items, and lore.

Want flickering lights and empty hallways? Or a relentless chase through something that shouldn’t exist? You decide.

Features:

  • Create Your Own Levels – Design interconnected spaces with full creative freedom

  • Customize Gameplay – Choose enemies, items, lighting, and difficulty

  • Dynamic Atmosphere – Control tension with sound, darkness, and environmental effects

  • Liminal Horror Focus – Capture the unsettling feeling of being somewhere you shouldn’t be

  • Endless Possibilities – Build, test, and refine your own unique Horror  game experience

Whether you're crafting a slow, psychological descent or a fast-paced escape from entities, Horror Game Creator gives you the tools to bring your vision to life.

The only limit is how far you're willing to go.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER/AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated DirectX 11 compatible soundcard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 3 1200, FX4350 or greater
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER/AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated DirectX 11 compatible soundcard
